<b>Horned Pilgrim</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are a pilgrim who arrived in [[Bone Bottom]] to start their journey to [[the Citadel]], found resting before setting out.

== In-game Events ==
Horned Pilgrim appears after [[Pebb]] leaves [[Bone Bottom]] and [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] visits the place where her shop used to be, provided the game is subsequently [[Save Data (Silksong)/Save Points|saved]] outside Bone Bottom, the [[Moss Grotto]], and [[the Marrow]]. In their first encounter, Horned Pilgrim asks Hornet about her [[Needle]] and wonders if it is a weapon.<ref>Horned Pilgrim: <i>"Sister, sister! What is that long, gleaming tooth you carry with you? Is it a weapon?"</i></ref> When she confirms this and recommends they arm themself before starting their journey, the pilgrim sadly refuses her advice and calls it a sin.<ref>Hornet and Horned Pilgrim dialogue:<br>Hornet: <i>"It is indeed, though you need not fear. I will not raise it against you. Its edge is meant for predators and other foes. I strongly suggest you arm yourself similarly before your own journey begins."</i><br>Horned Pilgrim: <i>"Alas... for a pilgrim, that's sin you speak of, sister. We arm ourselves with prayer, garb ourselves in faith, and hope they prove enough to reach the Citadel's glory. Such is our way..."</i></ref>

Horned Pilgrim disappears when the [[Skull Tyrant]] attacks the settlement, but returns once Hornet defeats the boss and re-enters the room.

Seeing Horned Pilgrim for the first time triggers a countdown of ten game saves. Once it expires, the pilgrim leaves the settlement and remains absent for the rest of the game.<ref group=Source name=code><code>GameManager.TimePassesElsewhere()</code> decrements <code>bonetownPilgrimHornedCount</code>.</ref> A save only counts if it occurs in a different area from the previous one.

== Location ==
Horned Pilgrim can be found in [[Bone Bottom]], between the [[wishwall]] and the [[Bellway]] station. They appear only after [[Pebb]] leaves on her pilgrimage.
